stem: What is Roddy's reason for moving the doghouse soon after he overhears his mother's telephone conversation?

options.label: A
options.text: He thinks repairing the doghouse will be a fun project.

options.label: B
options.text: He wants to spend time with Jacob before a new dog keeps him too busy.

options.label: C
options.text: He is expecting to meet Princess on his way home with the doghouse.

options.label: D
options.text: He wants to show that he can be responsible enough to own a dog.
